React version: without react

## Steps To Reproduce

1. Clone https://github.com/intsashka/typescript-error-project
2. Run `pnpm i`
3. Run `pnpm lint:tsc`

Link to code example: https://github.com/intsashka/typescript-error-project

## The current behavior
Typescript error:

```
> typescript-error-project@1.0.0 lint:tsc /Users/intsashka/projects/typescript-error-project
> tsc --noEmit

src/index.ts(8,13): error TS2322: Type '{ meta: { name: string; version: string; }; rules: { 'component-hook-factories': RuleModule; 'exhaustive-deps': { meta: { type: "suggestion"; docs: { description: string; recommended: true; url: string; }; fixable: "code"; hasSuggestions: true; schema: { ...; }[]; }; create(context: RuleContext): { ...; }; }; 'rules...' is not assignable to type 'Plugin'.
  Types of property 'configs' are incompatible.
    Type '{ recommended: { plugins: string[]; rules: RulesConfig; }; 'recommended-latest': { plugins: string[]; rules: RulesConfig; }; flat: { recommended: ReactHooksFlatConfig; "recommended-latest": ReactHooksFlatConfig; }; }' is not assignable to type 'Record<string, ConfigObject<RulesConfig> | LegacyConfigObject<RulesConfig, RulesConfig> | ConfigObject<RulesConfig>[]>'.
      Property 'flat' is incompatible with index signature.
        Type '{ recommended: ReactHooksFlatConfig; "recommended-latest": ReactHooksFlatConfig; }' is not assignable to type 'ConfigObject<RulesConfig> | LegacyConfigObject<RulesConfig, RulesConfig> | ConfigObject<RulesConfig>[]'.
 ELIFECYCLE  Command failed with exit code 2.
```


## The expected behavior

Typescript run without error.
raw.title: Bug: Typescript error when import pluginReactHooks from 'eslint-plugin-react-hooks';
